academic-term-duplicate: A term with this academic year and half already exists.
academic-term-dates-invalid: A term must start before it ends.
academic-term-bells-invalid: The bell schedule is invalid: each period may appear once per weekday and must end after it starts.
academic-term-non-study-day-invalid: A non-study day must fall inside the term.
academic-term-moved-day-invalid: A moved day must follow a weekday from Monday to Saturday.
academic-no-bell: The term has no bell for period {period} on this day.
academic-invalid-date-range: The date range is reversed or longer than three months.
academic-group-name-taken: An active group named {name} already exists.
academic-group-emis-id-taken: Another group is already linked to this EMIS group.
academic-curator-not-teacher: The curator must be a teacher.
academic-head-student-invalid: The head student must be an active student of this group.
academic-not-group-curator: Only the curator of this group or Administration can do this.
academic-subgroup-assignment-invalid: Every student must be an active student of this group, and the subgroup must be 1 or 2.
academic-subject-emis-id-taken: Another subject is already linked to this EMIS subject.
academic-subject-name-invalid: Enter the subject name in at least one language.
academic-room-slug-taken: Another room already uses the address {slug}.
academic-room-in-use: Future lessons still use this room.
academic-room-merge-invalid: A room cannot be merged into itself or into an archived room.
academic-entry-invalid: The timetable entry is not valid.
academic-import-invalid: The file cannot be read as a student list.
academic-import-expired: The import preview has expired. Upload the file again.
academic-term-control-periods-invalid: A control period is invalid: it must start on or before its end, lie inside the term and come after the previous control (midterm 1, midterm 2, final).
